chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said: “The boundary of Masjid al-Kufah is the end of the lamp-makers. Adam عليه السلام marked it, and I dislike entering it while riding.”

He was asked, “Who changed it from its original plan?” He said: “As for the first of that, it was the flood in the time of Nuh عليه السلام. Then the companions of Kisra and al-Nu'man changed it. Then Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan changed it.”

key_terms.زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ: Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan, mentioned as one who altered it

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the original boundaries of Masjid al-Kufah and who changed them?
ai.summary: This hadith states the original extent of Masjid al-Kufah and attributes its first marking to Adam عليه السلام. It also records later historical alterations to its layout and reflects the Imam’s reverence for the mosque by disliking entering it while mounted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.691 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The boundary of the Mosque of Kufa extends to the end of the lamp-makers' area. It was originally marked by Adam (as), and I dislike entering it while riding."

He was asked: "Who altered its original boundaries?"
Imam (as) said: "The first change occurred due to the flood during the time of Noah (as), followed by changes made by the companions of Khosrow (the Persian rulers) and al-Nu'man, and then later by Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan."
